newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia revises 1996 beet crop forecast.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia revises 1996 beet crop forecast.

text.p: Slovakia's 1996 sugar beet crop is forecast at 1.60-1.65 million tonnes, against a previous estimate of 1.57-1.64 million, the Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
"Sufficient rainfall favourably influenced the sugar beet crop, which is expected to be 38.1 percent higher than last year," SUSR said in a statement.
But it added, "Ongoing rain unfavourably affects the sugar content and the volume of harvest losses."
The bureau said the yield per hectare this year should reach 38.14 tonnes, according to the latest survey as of September 15, against the 37.63 tonnes forecast earlier.

Sown area rose to 42,600 ha in 1996 from 34,900 in 1995, the bureau said, adding that 34,335 hectares were actually harvested last year. It did not give an estimate of expected harvested area for 1996.
No percentage sugar content per beet forecast was immediately available.
Slovakia's 1995 sugar beet crop was 1.176 million tonnes, with a yield per hectare of 34.26 tonnes.
